Plaintiff No. 1, 'Borsad Tobacco Company Private Limited' and Plaintiff No. 2, 'Sopariwala India LLP' are companies incorporated and registered under the Companies Act, 1956 having its Registered Offices at Mumbai. Plaintiff No. 1 and 2 are both of the same group of companies known as 'Fazlani Group' having common Partners / Directors. 27. The Plaintiffs are a business group engaged in myriad industries, such as, agricultural commodities, ready-to-eat food products, tobacco, perfumery products, education, real estate, etc. 28. The learned Counsel for the Plaintiffs submitted that Plaintiff No. 1 selects the finest quality tobacco leaves from reputed local agents and farmers and Plaintiff No. 2 adheres to quality control protocol to ensure that only superior raw material is procured and processed under the optimal conditions. Defendant No. 1, 'SND Exports Private Limited' is engaged in the business of supplying, selling, and exporting of tobacco products operating from Rajasthan. Defendant No. 2, 'Dhariwal Exports' is engaged in the business of supplying, selling, and exporting of tobacco products operating from Gujarat and Rajasthan.
